statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog will add an entry for CVE-2026-81578 or CVE-2026-82078, the actively exploited PaperCut NG/MF flaws, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-05 and 2026-10-24.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists CVE-2026-81578 or CVE-2026-82078 with dateAdded inside the window, checked on 2026-10-26; FALSE if neither entry appears by then.
failure_condition: Neither CVE-2026-81578 nor CVE-2026-82078 has a dateAdded entry in the CISA KEV catalog on or before 2026-10-24.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: McKesson will file a document on SEC EDGAR, such as a Form 8-K/A or 10-Q, between 2026-09-05 and 2026-11-30 that states a specific number or bounded range of individuals affected by its August 2026 data theft incident.
resolution: TRUE if a McKesson SEC EDGAR filing dated in the window states a specific number or bounded range of affected individuals; FALSE if no such filing exists as of 2026-12-02.
